# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server entity trace along walked routes.
# map mp_pavlov, g_gametype dm, joined allies, weapon mosin_nagant_mp, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults, one client on the server.
# Captured with tools/run_server.sh and --net-probe --save-entities, one run
# per random spawn: a walk cannot be steered across the map, so coverage is
# several runs' stations sharing a file. Each run appends and rewrites,
# keeping at most 3 samples of any one entity set, since a fourth sample of a set
# already seen adds a position and no new visibility case.
# Every run is taken from a server one client has already joined and left:
# its ClientDisconnect frees entity 0, and G_FreeEntity's sweep turns every
# groundEntityNum still at G_Spawn's 0 (the script models, the turrets) to
# 1023, so a first run on a fresh server disagrees with every later one.
# One [sample] per station, carrying the probe's origin there and every entity
# the server had sent it as of that frame. The origin is what the gate replays:
# the route itself is not reproducible and does not need to be.
# Values are the raw i32 wire words, floats as their bit patterns. Names come
# from Protocol::entity_fields; a field a block does not list is zero.
[sample 0] spawn
